messages.content: The Denver flights are booked: I arrive Wednesday afternoon and leave Friday at 9:45 p.m. I need to settle the hotel tonight before the forum block closes. Can you compare the conference hotel with the nearby Larimer House for two nights, including every mandatory charge and tax?

Yes. The conference hotel is $189 per night. Its mandatory destination charge is $27 per night, and the 15.75% lodging tax applies to both the room and that charge. Two nights total $500.04: $378 room, $54 destination charges, and $68.04 tax.

Larimer House is $218 per night with no mandatory charge. With the same tax, its two-night total is $504.67: $436 room and $68.67 tax. Larimer House costs $4.63 more overall.
What does the conference rate actually include, and is the destination charge giving me anything useful or just increasing the displayed rate?

The $189 forum rate includes standard guest-room Wi-Fi and fitness-center access. The separate $27 daily charge includes a $20 food-and-beverage credit for that day, two bottles of water, and a premium Wi-Fi upgrade. The dining credit expires each night and does not reduce the mandatory charge. Larimer House includes standard Wi-Fi and gym access but no daily credit.
Check cancellation terms next. The block language looked stricter than the regular hotel policy.

It is. The conference booking can be canceled without charge until 11:59 p.m. Mountain Time five days before arrival. After that, the full $500.04 stay becomes nonrefundable. The discounted block closes tonight at 8:00 p.m.

Larimer House allows cancellation until 6:00 p.m. the day before arrival. A later cancellation incurs one night with tax, $252.34.
Now compare the walking. The Wednesday reception is at the conference hotel, but most of Thursday and Friday is at the convention center. Also account for getting to DEN Friday evening.

From the conference hotel, the reception is on site and the convention center is about a six-minute walk. Larimer House is roughly 15 minutes from the reception and 11 minutes from the convention center.

For DEN, Larimer House has the advantage: it is about eight minutes on foot from Union Station, versus approximately 17 minutes from the conference hotel. The A Line then takes about 37 minutes. Rideshare times from either hotel are similar, generally 35 to 55 minutes depending on traffic.
Do both standard rooms have a coffee maker and a refrigerator?

Neither standard-room description guarantees both. The conference hotel lists a single-cup coffee maker, but refrigerators are only available on request and subject to availability. Larimer House lists a mini-fridge, while coffee makers are limited to upgraded rooms. Should either property be removed from consideration, or do you want to relax one of those room criteria for this stay?
For this Denver trip only, I am fine relaxing the refrigerator requirement. I will barely be in the room. I do want the coffee maker, so keep the conference hotel in the comparison.

Then the conference hotel is the stronger practical choice. It guarantees the coffee maker, eliminates the Wednesday reception walk, shortens the walk on both conference days, and is $4.63 less. Larimer House offers much better cancellation flexibility and a quicker airport-train departure, but those benefits require more walking throughout the event.
For the Friday flight, when would I need to leave each hotel if I use the train and want to be at the airport two hours early?

For a 9:45 p.m. departure, the airport target is 7:45 p.m. Allowing for the walk, train schedule, and a modest transfer buffer, leave Larimer House around 6:35 p.m. From the conference hotel, leave around 6:25 p.m. The conference hotel can hold your luggage after checkout, so you can collect it after the final session.
The event convenience matters more than the extra ten minutes on Friday. Reserve the conference rate for Wednesday and Thursday nights using the traveler and payment details already on file.

Reserved the conference hotel for two nights at the forum rate. The confirmed total is $500.04, including both destination charges and tax. Confirmation: QFD-48271. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Mountain Time five days before arrival; after that, the entire stay is nonrefundable. The reservation notes an afternoon Wednesday arrival and includes complimentary luggage storage after Friday checkout.
